body.name: Deathstep Boots
body.description: Boots designed solely for speed. The sole uses the light, springy shell of an insect, while the outer layer is lined with delicate wings. When worn, the wearer moves with a gliding swiftness, but the boots offer no protection. Taking even a single hit can be crippling. Suited for those who must move fast, even at great risk.

body.name: Diary of the Toz
body.description: The king's former court wizard, composed this haunting diary detailing his descent into the darkest arcane arts to satisfy the king’s sinister ambitions. His quest for forbidden knowledge turned him into a Lich, eternally chained to the castle he cursed with his master, a chilling reflection on the price of unwavering loyalty to dark magic.

body.description: A formidable double-sided axe with silver adornments, combining raw power with a raw power.

body.name: Divine Blade
body.description: A weapon of divine retribution, its hefty weight is balanced by the precision with which it cleaves through foes.

body.name: Divine Bow
body.description: With its silver-infused craftsmanship, this bow is as visually striking as it is effective.

body.name: Divine Dagger
body.description: The silver detailing on this dagger elevates its appeal, making it a prized possession for any skilled wielder.

body.name: Divine Rod
body.description: With its simple silver inclusions, this mace is a solid choice for those facing undead opponents.

body.name: Divine Short Sword
body.description: A straightforward weapon, its silver edge makes it a dependable choice in combat against undead entities.

body.name: Divine Staff
body.description: Expertly crafted, is an ideal fusion of power and grace, suitable for both defensive and offensive maneuvers.
